capabilities: Render a gdcard YAML block as a structured card in reading view
Edit card fields in place and write changes back to the note
Add attributes and balance metrics from configurable pools
Browse cards in a grid library filtered by status and sorted by several fields
Batch rename card files by title and update incoming wikilinks
disambiguation: Not a flashcard or spaced-repetition tool; the cards are game-design documents stored as YAML in a code block.
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and includes five sample cards in sample/卡片/. Data lives in a code block rather than frontmatter, so Dataview and Bases cannot query it. Reading view is recommended; edits are saved only when focus leaves the card. Licensed MPL-2.0.
problem: Game-design notes for weapons and items have no fixed layout, so it is hard to see which fields are still empty or to compare balance numbers and dev status across cards.
summary: Renders a fenced gdcard YAML block as an editable game-design card with attributes, balance metrics, dev status, and a filterable card library.
